register.name: Producentansvarsregistret
register.notes: Vadlīniju lapa iegūta 2026-08-16 (pēdējoreiz pārskatīta 11.08.2026, jau atspoguļo PPWR izmaiņas no 12.08.2026). Reģistrācija un ziņošana caur Naturvårdsverket e-pakalpojumu; ražotāji maksā iepakojuma maksu savai producentansvarsorganisation (PRO). Saskaņā ar PPWR noteikumiem personām, uz kurām attiecas ES ražotāja definīcija, jāreģistrējas un jāziņo katru gadu līdz 31. martam (pirmais termiņš 31.03.2027 par periodu 12.08.–31.12.2026).

pro.ecoModulation: Fees split by recyclability: plastics 13.40 (recyclable) / 18.02 (limited) / 19.56 (non-recyclable) SEK/kg; paper 6.67 vs 9.65 SEK/kg. Consumer (privat bruk) vs commercial use priced completely differently — commercial packaging is nearly free (e.g. recyclable paper 0.01 SEK/kg).

notes: Rates from the official NPA 'Förpackningsavgifter' list decided 24.11.2025, valid from 01.01.2026 (fetched 2026-08-16), household (privat bruk) recyclable-compatible categories, converted at 11.01 SEK/EUR (2026-08-16): paper 6.67 SEK/kg → 0.606; plastic 13.40 → 1.217; glass 2.80 → 0.254; aluminium 12.59 → 1.143 (shown as 'metal'; steel 21.49 → 1.951); wood single-use 13.70 → 1.244 (rises to 15.70 → ≈1.43 from 01.04.2026). No separate beverage-carton row — liquid cartons fall under the paper 'limited/not recyclable' band 9.65 SEK/kg ≈ 0.876 ('composite' left null). Swedish fees jumped sharply in 2025–2026 after municipalities took over collection. NPA invoices in SEK — EUR values are indicative conversions.
